concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: an EMERALD-CRYSTAL FOX CUB, the first stage of a two-stage Wood evolution line, in the same view and pose as image 1, standing on four short legs, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 round head with face; 2 big fox ears with emerald crystal clusters; 3 small body; 4 root collar with crystal pendant; 5 four short legs; 6 bushy tail with a crystal leaf;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 round head with face: a round fox-cub head: slate-grey fur on top and sides, a cream face mask around the eyes and muzzle, two big lemon-yellow eyes (one catchlight dot each) exactly where the old eyes are, brows angled down, a small dark nose, a confident grin with one tiny fang (smaller than the old open mouth); slate-grey cheek fluff with cream tips where the old green tufts are; no forehead symbol, no red.
2 big fox ears with emerald crystal clusters: two big pointed fox ears, slate grey outside and cream inside, where the orange ears are; behind each ear a cluster of flat emerald-green crystal shards growing from the head, sweeping up-left on the viewer-left and standing up on the viewer-right, about the size of the old leaves, with a few darker emerald facet lines; a small curled slate-grey fur tuft on top of the head; no leaves, no orange.
3 small body: a small slate-grey body with a cream belly and a few small flat emerald crystal shards along its back.
4 root collar with crystal pendant: a thin twisted dark-brown root cord following the same path across the neck, with the same loop on the viewer-left and curl on the viewer-right; instead of the berry a flat emerald crystal pendant with three tiny emerald chips on top; no red berry, no leaves, no yellow band.
5 four short legs: four short slate-grey legs with cream paws at the bottom and small dark toe lines; no green, no tan.
6 bushy tail with a crystal leaf: a bushy slate-grey fox tail curving up from the rump to the upper-left, carrying a big flat emerald crystal leaf at its tip with a few darker emerald facet lines; no stem, no tendrils, no teal leaf.

ATTITUDE: a bold little fox ready to pounce: brows angled down, a small fang in a confident grin; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those.

COLOURS: slate-grey fur, a cream belly, face mask and ear insides, flat emerald-green crystals with a few darker emerald facet lines (no sparkle), a dark-brown root cord, lemon-yellow eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: a green body, orange ears, red eyes, white fur, brown horns, leaves on a stem, a red berry, a glowing magic circle on the ground, a gold crown, glowing green flame wisps, sparkles, crystal shine, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
